linux_stepper_init.tooltip: Create a deterministic four-output stepper controller for an external driver.

linux_stepper_move.message0: move stepper %1 by signed steps %2 at %3 RPM
linux_stepper_move.tooltip: Move by signed sequence steps; negative values reverse direction.

linux_stepper_rotate.message0: rotate stepper %1 by signed angle %2 degrees at %3 RPM
linux_stepper_rotate.tooltip: Convert a signed angle to the configured sequence steps and move.

linux_stepper_position.tooltip: Read the commanded position since initialization; this is open-loop, not measured feedback.

linux_stepper_release.tooltip: Drive all four driver inputs low without closing their GPIO resources.

linux_stepper_close.tooltip: Release coils, close all four GPIO outputs, and release the controller.
